dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a distinctive secondary notch-like protrusion near the posterior base, creating a complex spline profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius at the morphological tip, classified as rounded-acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, approximately 70 degrees relative to the visible dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible base width is approximately equal to the vertical height from the ridge to the apex (1:1).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly rounded convex arc with a medium radius defining the forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Highly elongated and narrow linear projection with a high length-to-thickness ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Defined obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the convex melon slope meets the straight dorsal margin of the rostrum.
